watch.summary: The streamer hypes himself up as he scores an aerial goal in Rocket League and screams in celebration.

beats.what: Streamer trash-talks after a scored goal, yelling 'get him outta here'.
Streamer pushes the ball down the field towards the opponent's net.
Streamer hits the ball into the top corner past the defender.
The goal explodes into purple effects.
Streamer screams at the top of his lungs in hype.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: This is a competitive gameplay highlight driven by high energy and skill rather than comedy. The loudness and excitement function as excitement rather than a structured joke or funny moment.
